description: Land Acquisition - Waharaka, Ruwanwella D/S Division, Kegalle District - Amended Ext. Gaz. No. 2236/30 dated 2021.07.14, Kabithigollawa D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Errata, Ex. Gaz. No. 2249/11 dated 12.10.2021 Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes (resettlement of families and water supply projects), including descriptions of the lands, their locations, extents, and original claimants. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
